```artifact
Feature: Patient Management and Workflow

  Scenario Outline: Query on Patient Id and modify details
    Given a patient with ID <patient_id> and pin-code <pin_code>
    When I query the patient details
    Then the patient details should be displayed
    And I should be able to modify the details
    And the pin-code should not be modified to be outside the Zone

    Examples:
      | patient_id | pin_code |
      | 12345      | 1234     |
      | 67890      | 5678     |
      | 11111      | 9012     |

  Scenario Outline: Query on Patient Id and create appointment
    Given a patient with ID <patient_id>
    When I query the patient details
    And I enter details like Speciality, Symptoms, Consultation request, Appointment date
    Then an entry should be created in the Patient Appointment file if the Appointment Request is for next day

    Examples:
      | patient_id | speciality | symptoms | consultation_request | appointment_date |
      | 12345      | Cardiology | Fever    | Yes                  | 2023-10-05       |
      | 67890      | Neurology  | Headache | No                   | 2023-10-06       |
      | 11111      | Pediatrics | Cough    | Yes                  | 2023-10-07       |

  Scenario Outline: Doctor sees consultation requests and provides consultation
    Given a doctor sees the workflow consultation requests
    When the doctor selects a consultation request
    Then the doctor should be able to provide consultation
    And the doctor should be able to enter Diagnosis, Prescribe medicines, and request for lab tests

    Examples:
      | consultation_request_id | diagnosis | medicines | lab_tests |
      | 1001                    | Fever     | Paracetamol | CBC       |
      | 1002                    | Headache  | Ibuprofen   | Blood Test|
      | 1003                    | Cough     | Amoxicillin | X-ray     |

  Scenario Outline: Chemist sees prescriptions and dispenses medicines
    Given a chemist sees the workflow consultation requests
    When the chemist selects a prescription
    Then the chemist should be able to dispense medicines
    And the flag in the prescription should be marked

    Examples:
      | prescription_id | medicines | flag |
      | 2001            | Paracetamol | Dispensed |
      | 2002            | Ibuprofen   | Dispensed |
      | 2003            | Amoxicillin | Dispensed |

  Scenario Outline: Lab sees prescriptions and notes lab requests
    Given a lab sees the workflow consultation requests
    When the lab selects a prescription
    Then the lab should be able to note down the lab requests
    And the flag in the prescription should be marked
    And the lab report should be added

    Examples:
      | prescription_id | lab_tests | flag | report |
      | 3001            | CBC       | Noted | CBC Report |
      | 3002            | Blood Test| Noted | Blood Test Report |
      | 3003            | X-ray     | Noted | X-ray Report |
```
